# Atlas One

Atlas One is an Israeli ticketing platform for concerts, parties, festivals and live events.

Canonical website: https://www.atlas-one.co

## Important pages
- Home and events: https://www.atlas-one.co
- About: https://www.atlas-one.co/about
- FAQ: https://www.atlas-one.co/faq
- Careers: https://www.atlas-one.co/careers
- Contact: https://www.atlas-one.co/contact
- Privacy: https://www.atlas-one.co/privacy
- Terms: https://www.atlas-one.co/terms
- Refund policy: https://www.atlas-one.co/refund-policy

## Guidance
Public event pages contain the authoritative date, venue, ticket categories and price information. Checkout, office, admin, API and scanner routes are transactional or private and should not be indexed.
